en: An old colored postcard showing two steamships moored side by side in a harbor at sunset. Both ships fly tricolor flags of Romania (vertical stripes of blue, yellow, and red). The name "Constanţa" appears at the upper left, and the ships bear the names "Traian" (or "Împ. Traian") and "România" on their sterns. There is printed text in Romanian at the upper right and faint handwritten text across the lower part of the image.
